captions.detailed: A classic naval ship-deck truck cannon featuring a thick, dark cast-iron barrel with integrated trunnions. The barrel is mounted on a brown wooden carriage frame composed of stepped side cheeks and crossbeams. Four solid wooden truck wheels are attached to the lower corners via rotating axles, and a wooden quoin wedge is positioned under the breech to adjust the barrel's elevation.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a naval ship-deck truck cannon with a dark cast-iron barrel on a wooden carriage. The barrel should pivot on trunnions, and the carriage should feature four solid wheels on rotating axles and an adjustable wooden quoin wedge for elevation control.
captions.factory: Construct the main carriage base and side cheeks using Box primitives. Model the cannon barrel using a combination of Cylinder primitives for the main body and trunnions, and a Sphere for the cascabel. Create the four wheels using Cylinder primitives oriented along the Y-axis, and define revolute joints for both the wheels and the barrel trunnions, along with a prismatic joint for the elevation quoin wedge.
